description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy@1 (%) of two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes (tree width), with values ranging from 1 to 7 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy@1 (%) on a linear scale from 15 to 35. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows an increasing trend in accuracy from 24.4% at 1 child node to a peak of 34.4% at 5 child nodes, followed by a decline to 31.1% at 7 child nodes. In contrast, the Claude-3.5-Sonnet model, represented by a dashed light blue line with star markers, exhibits a decreasing trend in accuracy from 26.7% at 1 child node to 20.0% at 7 child nodes, with intermediate values of 27.8% at 3 child nodes and 24.4% at 5 child nodes.
